description:
Variation of Condition 2 (approved plans) attached to planning permission PL/0107/25 dated 18.3.2025 to read:  ''2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and
documents: Reasonable Exception Statement, Design and Access Statement, 23/3590/33A, 23/3590/32A, 23/3590/21, Site Location
Plan''
decision_conditions: Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015 (or any order revoking and re-enacting that order with or without modification), no window(s)/door(s), other than those shown on the approved plans shall be installed in the flank elevation(s) of the development hereby permitted without the prior permission in writing of the local planning authority.
The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:&nbsp;Reasonable Exception Statement, Design and Access Statement, 23/3590/33A, 23/3590/32A, 23/3590/21, Site Location
Plan

<p>The detached outbuildings hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes incidental to the residential use of the occupiers of&nbsp;<span style="line-height: 16.1px;">19 Sudbury Court Drive,&nbsp; Harrow, HA1 3SZ</span>&nbsp;and shall at no point be used as primary living accommodation, rental purposes or any other similar use.</p><p>REASON: To safeguard the amenity of neighbouring residents and the character of the locality in accordance with Policy DM1 of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013).</p>

<span style="font-size:12pt;"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;">The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of planning permission </span></span><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif;"><span style="font-size:12pt;">PL/0107/25 </span></span><span style="font-size:12pt;">dated&nbsp;<span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">18.3.2025</span></span><span style="font-size:12pt"><span style="font-family:Arial,Helvetica,sans-serif">.<br><br></span></span>
